metadata.description: Evaluation and comparison of BM25, Dense, and Hybrid (RRF) retrieval strategies

metric_definitions.recall_at_k: Fraction of relevant gold chunks retrieved in the top 10
metric_definitions.mrr: Reciprocal rank (1/rank) of the first relevant chunk retrieved
metric_definitions.ndcg_at_k: Normalized discounted cumulative gain at rank 10 with binary relevance
metric_definitions.rrf_score: Reciprocal Rank Fusion score: sum(1 / (rrf_k + rank_i)) across BM25 and Dense

metadata.corpus_limitation_note: The current corpus contains 11 chunks from 5 selected pages of RM0090. Top-10 retrieval captures 10/11 chunks (90.9% of corpus), making high recall expected across all methods. Differences between strategies primarily manifest in ranking metrics (MRR and nDCG@10) and latency.
metadata.timing_methodology: Each query is warmed up before measurement. Timing is measured over repeated iterations (20 repeats) using time.perf_counter(). Dense query latency includes query embedding and cosine similarity computation, excluding one-time model initialization.
